about.name: Dr. Aman Jain
about.tagline: Transforming HR from a Function to a Strategic Growth Engine
paragraphs: Dr. Aman Jain is a distinguished HR Leader and an Talent & Organizational Development subject matter expert with over 16+ years of experience. He excels in translating business needs into effective HR strategies, utilizing assessment centres, learning initiatives, and talent management interventions.

Aman currently serves as CHRO at e2E Rail, a Railway Infrastructure Company based in Bengaluru. He was previously the Head - Corporate HR at major Hospitality Chain – Sterling Holiday Resorts Limited, overseeing various Centre of Excellence such as HR Operations (Payroll, HRMS, Compliance & Statutory), Talent & Org Development, HR Business Partnering, Employer Branding, Talent Engagement, and Digitization, Analytics, & Business Excellence.

stories.subtitle: What Leaders Say About Working Together

cards.quote: "Working under Dr. Aman Jain at Sterling Holidays was truly enriching. As Head of L&D, his vision, strategic thinking, and hands-on leadership transformed the learning culture. He built impactful frameworks, leadership pathways, and capability programs while mentoring others with empathy and clarity. His guidance helped me grow personally and professionally. Dr. Aman is a rare leader who genuinely invests in people, and I'm grateful for the opportunity to learn from him. Wishing him continued success."
cards.name: Sumosh Nair
cards.role: Heading L&D Globally across diverse industries — Hospitality, Logistics, Automotive, Telecom, & ITES for leading brands including Sterling Holidays, Nissan, BMW, Renault, Idea, Tata Docomo & Amazon.

cards.quote: "Dr. Aman is an enthusiastic business partner who is able to think out of the box while designing and delivering solutions. I enjoyed collaborating with him on L&D and talent initiatives. He is a keen learner and keeps himself updated of the latest trends in HR. He stretches himself to develop scalable and sustainable solutions. He has a strong sense of ownership towards the initiatives he runs. With a curious mind and an open attitude towards new experiences, I am confident that he is a great leader in the making."
cards.name: Surabhi Loshali
